note: Normative product behavior. Each rule is enterprise-default and changeable via a PDR. 'ui' notes the UX the rule implies.

rules.title: Approval routing by risk & ownership
rules.statement: A request routes to approvers determined by the matching approval policy: the beneficiary's manager first, then the owner(s) of each requested entitlement/role/app. High/critical-risk items add an extra owner or admin step.
rules.ui: Show the full approval chain and current step on request/approval detail.

rules.title: Escalation on timeout
rules.statement: A pending approval that exceeds its SLA (default 3 business days) auto-escalates to the approver's manager and is flagged overdue. It never auto-approves.
rules.ui: Overdue tasks are warning-intent; show due/overdue time and escalation state.

rules.title: Self-approval prohibited
rules.statement: A requester cannot approve their own request. If they are the only eligible approver, the task escalates to the next level.
rules.ui: Hide approve/reject on one's own request; explain if it would otherwise appear.

rules.title: Risk score computation
rules.statement: Risk score (0-100) is the weighted sum of active risk factors, bucketed to a level: 0-24 low, 25-49 medium, 50-74 high, 75-100 critical. Factors include privileged access, SoD exposure, dormant usage, and access breadth.
rules.ui: One badge component, one level→color mapping, used everywhere risk appears.

rules.title: Request risk surfacing
rules.statement: A request's risk = the max risk of its items, raised one level if it introduces an SoD conflict. Approvers always see request risk before deciding.
rules.ui: Risk badge + SoD flag prominent on approval cards and detail.

rules.title: Every governed object has an owner
rules.statement: Applications, entitlements, and roles must have an assigned owner (an active identity). Objects lacking a valid owner are flagged 'ownerless' and routed to an administrator.
rules.ui: Ownerless objects are warning-intent and filterable; require owner on create.

rules.title: Ownership transfer preserves history
rules.statement: Reassigning ownership records who/when and retains prior owner in history. In-flight approvals assigned to the prior owner reassign to the new owner.
rules.ui: Show ownership history; confirm reassignment impact on open tasks.

rules.title: Campaign scope & reviewer assignment
rules.statement: Each certification item is assigned to the most specific responsible reviewer: manager for user-access reviews, owner for app/role/entitlement reviews. Unassignable items go to an administrator.
rules.ui: Reviewer inbox scoped to assigned items; show why an item is assigned to you.

rules.title: Revocation triggers deprovisioning
rules.statement: Revoking a certification item creates a deprovisioning action for that access (simulated). Certified items are recorded as evidence with reviewer, timestamp, and comment.
rules.ui: Revoke shows consequence ('user loses access'); require comment on revoke.

rules.title: No self-certification
rules.statement: A reviewer cannot certify their own access. Such items reassign to the reviewer's manager.
rules.ui: Filter out / reassign self items; explain the reassignment.

rules.title: Time-bound access & expiry
rules.statement: Access may be permanent or time-bound (30/90/custom days). Time-bound grants auto-expire and notify the holder before expiry (default 7 days prior). High-risk access defaults to time-bound.
rules.ui: Duration selector on request; expiry countdown on granted access; renewal prompt.

rules.title: Emergency access auto-expiry
rules.statement: Emergency (break-glass) access is always time-bound (default 4 hours) and auto-expires. It cannot be made permanent.

rules.title: Mandatory post-use review
rules.statement: Every emergency grant requires a post-expiry review of actions taken, completed by an administrator. Unreviewed grants are flagged until reviewed.
rules.ui: Review queue; unreviewed grants surface on admin/audit dashboards.

rules.title: Preventive SoD blocks at request time
rules.statement: If a requested item would create a violation of a 'preventive' SoD policy, the request is blocked (or requires a justified exception) before submission.
rules.ui: Inline SoD warning in the cart showing both conflicting sides; block or require exception.

rules.title: Detective SoD flags after the fact
rules.statement: 'Detective' SoD policies do not block but generate an open violation when a conflicting combination exists (e.g. from lifecycle changes), for remediation.
rules.ui: Open violations on dashboards; violation detail shows both sides + severity.

rules.title: Exceptions are time-bound & justified
rules.statement: An SoD exception requires a justification and an expiry; on expiry the violation reopens for re-remediation.
rules.ui: Exception form: justification (required) + expiry; show exception status & expiry.

rules.title: Joiner birthright provisioning
rules.statement: On a joiner event, the identity receives birthright roles derived from department/title. Exceptions (no policy match, high-risk) are flagged for the manager.

rules.title: Mover access recalculation
rules.statement: On a mover event, the system computes the access delta (grant new birthright, revoke access tied to the prior role/dept). Risky removals require manager confirmation.
rules.ui: Before/after access diff; confirm risky removals.

rules.title: Leaver full deprovisioning
rules.statement: On a leaver event, all access is revoked and accounts disabled by the effective date. Any remaining access after completion is an exception and flagged.
